scope: Incremental closed-form depletion charges, not a complete replacement of the remaining Dual evaluator

profile.method: V8 CPU samples, source-map-resolved inclusive frame counts; counts rather than timeDelta-weighted durations; includes startup, hashing and GC

oracle.coverage: NPN/PNP normalized branches; -40/27/125 C; default and rich substrate/excess-phase/RTH models; ME/MC/MS=0,0.33,0.95; FC=0,0.9,0.99; forward/reverse/zero/saturation and +/-1e-15 around all depletion boundaries; seeded independent random branches
oracle.self_heating: RTH is electrically inert in the currently supported four-terminal isothermal subset
oracle.oracle_implementation: Pre-analytic Dual depletion integral substituted into complete current evaluator in test-only compiled source. All residual, charge and noise values and branch derivatives compared. No runtime export or oracle path.

timings.method: six alternating-order pairs, fresh processes, saved complete matching dist trees restored before each run, no warmup, no completed measurement discarded

identity.stamp_scope: Existing vbic-vtf.test.ts default device stamp fingerprint, not a full DFF stamp stream hash
identity.ngspice_accuracy: No numerical change in DFF output; prior round-9 ngspice comparison remains unchanged, not newly remeasured or improved
